description: Should-not-fire case. User asks a pure GitHub-API question (list open PRs via gh CLI / REST). The word 'API' plus the fact that Agent Hub *does* integrate with GitHub elsewhere makes this a classic false-positive hook. The skill's anti-trigger clause explicitly excludes unrelated third-party APIs. Verifies the agent answers with gh / api.github.com rather than pulling in the Agent Hub scripts.
query: How do I list all open pull requests in the owner/repo GitHub repository using the REST API, filtered to those touching the server/ directory? I'm scripting this in a standalone shell script, not inside Agent Hub.

expected_behavior.rationale: None of the Agent Hub wrappers help answer a GitHub REST API question — pulling them in is a mis-trigger.
Local Agent Hub API has no endpoint for third-party GitHub queries; mentioning them signals a false trigger.
Correct response uses the actual GitHub surface (REST endpoint, gh CLI, or token env var).
